text.p: Consolidated Health Care Associates Inc said on Monday that it accepted the resignation of Alan Mantell as chief executive officer, vice chairman and member of the board.
The position of CEO has been eliminated, said company President Robert Whitty in a telephone interview.
Whitty said James Kenney, a member of the board since 1992, has been elected the company's chairman.
Kenney replaces Joel Friedman, who remains a member of the board, Whitty said. Raymond LeBlanc, chief financial officer, was elected as secretary of the company, the statement said.
Whitty said he has assumed responsibility for the operations of the company.

"These management changes are part of Consolidated continuing to turn itself around," Whitty said. "We posted a $600,000 loss in 1995. For 1996 we expect to see only a marginal loss, and during the year we've absorbed significant non-recurring expenses."
